title: Waldmühle Hauptwand — document the sector
objective: Bring back one clean, review-ready package for the main wall: where it is, what it looks like, how you get there, and anything a climber should know before racking up.
needs: A GPS point at the central wall base
A full frontal photo with both edges visible
The approach from practical parking/transit
Photos of any access or restriction signs
Notes on anything that conflicts with the topo

checklist.title: Confirm sector GPS position
checklist.help: Stand at the central wall base and capture a location point.

checklist.title: Capture a full frontal wall overview
checklist.help: Keep both wall edges in frame; avoid steep perspective.

checklist.title: Record the approach track
checklist.help: Start where a climber actually parks or gets off transit.

checklist.title: Photograph access & restriction signs
checklist.help: Include private-property and seasonal notices if present.

checklist.title: Note route order left-to-right
checklist.help: Flag any conflict with the current topo. Observation, not judgement.

title: Mizzi-Langer-Wand — access & parking check
objective: Confirm how climbers reach and park at this crag right now, and capture any access notice. Quick in-and-out mission.
needs: A photo of the current parking situation
A photo of any access / restriction sign
A short note on the walk-in from parking

checklist.title: Photograph the parking area
checklist.help: Show where a climber would actually leave a car.

checklist.title: Photograph access signs
checklist.help: Any restriction, seasonal closure, or private-property notice.

checklist.title: Note the walk-in
checklist.help: Roughly how long from parking to the base, and the start point.

title: Glocknergrat — transcribe guidebook routes
objective: The guidebook spread for this sector is uploaded but not yet turned into route records. Transcribe the routes so they can be verified and published.
needs: Each route's name, grade, and route number
The book page each route is on
A confidence note on anything hard to read

checklist.title: Transcribe the route list
checklist.help: Name, grade and number for each route on the spread.

checklist.title: Attach the guidebook spread photo
checklist.help: So a reviewer can check your transcription against the source.

title: Peilstein — overview photography
objective: Collect clean overview photography of the main faces for the topo work. No route-level detail needed yet.
needs: Frontal overviews of the main faces
A note on light conditions and time of day

checklist.title: Photograph the main faces
checklist.help: One clean frontal frame per face, edges visible.

checklist.title: Note light & time
checklist.help: When you shot and the light — helps the topo team.

title: Efeugrat — photo set for a 3D scan
objective: A structured, overlapping photo set is enough to build a rough 3D model of the wall — no drone or special gear required.
needs: 20–40 overlapping photos circling the wall
Consistent light (avoid deep shifting shadows mid-shoot)
A few close-ups of distinctive rock features

checklist.title: Shoot an overlapping circuit
checklist.help: Walk the base, photo every few steps, ~60-70% overlap between shots.

checklist.title: Add a few close-up detail shots
checklist.help: Distinctive cracks or features help the reconstruction lock together.

title: Hohe Wand — overview from above
objective: A drone overview or a hand-stitched panorama gives contributors and climbers a sense of scale a ground photo can't.
needs: A drone or panoramic overview of the wall
GPS of where it was shot from

checklist.title: Capture the overview
checklist.help: Drone shot or a panorama stitched from a few overlapping frames.

checklist.title: GPS of the shooting position
checklist.help: So we know the vantage point this was taken from.

title: Every session: one GPS pin, one photo
objective: No specific crag — just a habit. If every visit adds one GPS pin and one photo somewhere, the map fills in on its own over a season.
needs: A GPS pin from wherever you were
One photo — route, wall, or approach

checklist.title: Drop a GPS pin
checklist.help: Doesn't need to be exact — roughly where you climbed.

checklist.title: Add one photo
checklist.help: Whatever you already shot works fine.
